question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id,
    b.over_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_over_runs
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
high_score_overs AS (
  SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.total_runs
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs = m.max_over_runs
),
bowler_runs_per_over AS (
  SELECT 
    h.match_id,
    h.over_id,
    b.bowler,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as runs_conceded
  FROM high_score_overs h
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON h.match_id = b.match_id AND h.over_id = b.over_id
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.match_id, h.over_id, b.bowler
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs
  FROM bowler_runs_per_over
  GROUP BY bowler
),
top_bowlers AS (
  SELECT bm.bowler, bm.max_runs
  FROM bowler_max_runs bm
  JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(max_runs) as overall_max
    FROM bowler_max_runs
  ) overall ON bm.max_runs = overall.overall_max
  ORDER BY bm.max_runs DESC, bm.bowler ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
bowler_best_record AS (
  SELECT 
    tb.bowler,
    tb.max_runs,
    br.match_id
  FROM top_bowlers tb
  JOIN bowler_runs_per_over br ON tb.bowler = br.bowler AND tb.max_runs = br.runs_conceded
  WHERE br.runs_conceded = tb.max_runs
)
SELECT bb.bowler, p.player_name, bb.match_id, m.venue, m.match_date
FROM bowler_best_record bb
JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY bb.max_runs DESC, bb.bowler

    b.match_id,
    b.over_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
  SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_over_runs
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
high_score_overs AS (
  SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.total_runs
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs = m.max_over_runs
),
bowler_runs_per_over AS (
  SELECT 
    h.match_id,
    h.over_id,
    b.bowler,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as runs_conceded
  FROM high_score_overs h
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON h.match_id = b.match_id AND h.over_id = b.over_id
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.match_id, h.over_id, b.bowler
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs
  FROM bowler_runs_per_over
  GROUP BY bowler
),
overall_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_runs) as overall_max
  FROM bowler_max_runs
),
top_bowlers AS (
  SELECT bm.bowler, bm.max_runs
  FROM bowler_max_runs bm
  JOIN overall_max om ON bm.max_runs = om.overall_max
  ORDER BY bm.max_runs DESC, bm.bowler ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
bowler_best_record AS (
  SELECT 
    tb.bowler,
    tb.max_runs,
    br.match_id
  FROM top_bowlers tb
  JOIN bowler_runs_per_over br ON tb.bowler = br.bowler AND tb.max_runs = br.runs_conceded
  WHERE br.runs_conceded = tb.max_runs
)
SELECT bb.bowler, p.player_name, bb.match_id, m.venue, m.match_date, bb.max_runs
FROM bowler_best_record bb
JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY bb.max_runs DESC, bb.bowler
